mapper.select: SELECT id, publisher_id AS publisherId, publisher_username AS publisherUsername, title, content, category, tags, location, animal_type AS animalType, images, status, view_count AS viewCount, like_count AS likeCount, comment_count AS commentCount, audit_opinion AS auditOpinion, audit_time AS auditTime, auditor_id AS auditorId, create_time AS createTime, update_time AS updateTime, is_deleted AS isDeleted FROM community_post WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0

SELECT COUNT(*) AS totalCount, SUM(CASE WHEN status = '已通过' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS approvedCount, SUM(CASE WHEN status = '待审核' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pendingCount, SUM(CASE WHEN status = '已拒绝' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS rejectedCount, SUM(view_count) AS totalViewCount, SUM(like_count) AS totalLikeCount, SUM(comment_count) AS totalCommentCount FROM community_post WHERE is_deleted = 0
SELECT category, COUNT(*) AS count FROM community_post WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND category IS NOT NULL GROUP BY category
